comparison.objective: Reverse a ratchet, loosen a bolt, and return the tool versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Mode inspection, lever flipping, socket seating, and repeated ratchet strokes versus hex-key seating, setscrew loosening, fine collar rotation, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt backed out a full turn without tightening damage and ratchet returned versus two acceptable impact cycles and stable locking.
comparison.reason: Tool alignment and rotary fastener work overlap only at a generic level; the candidate's core iterative dynamic calibration is absent. PR-1470 has no indexed spec versions, but its detailed body establishes the distinction.
